listenings.text: Good morning, everyone. A quick notice before we start. Today the day shift begins at seven, not at six thirty. The crew for the north tunnel meets at the main gate, and the crew for the south tunnel stays here in the office. We take the first break at nine thirty, and lunch is at noon. One more thing: the visitor from Seattle arrives on Monday, so please keep the site clean and tidy. Thank you, and have a safe shift.

Hi Giovanna, this is Karen Booth. I am the engineer from the London office, and I arrive in Brazil on Thursday. A little about my background: I have a degree in geotechnical engineering, and I work on metro projects. My commute in London is fifty minutes, so I know long mornings very well. Could we catch up at the site on Friday morning? Any time after nine is fine for me. Thank you, and see you soon.

extra_audio.text: Giovanna leaves home and starts her commute. She arrives at the site at seven. She meets the tunnel crew at the main gate. She works with the crew until the break. At the break she catches up with the new engineer.
